g.data-label: Look up full-throttle timing curve from WOTMAP table
g.text: Look up full-throttle timing curve from WOTMAP table

g.data-label: Is the engine in boost? (Manifold pressure above atmospheric reference OBCONST)
No boost retard needed (0° offset)
Calculate boost retard offset: Boost Retard = (MAP - OBCONST) * ARADVR
Look up part-throttle base curve from HOTMAP table
g.text: Look up part-throttle base curve from HOTMAP table

g.data-label: Subtract boost retard from base curve: Part-Throttle Timing = HOTMAP - Boost Retard

g.data-label: Did timing drop below the full-throttle curve? (Part-Throttle Timing < WOTMAP)

text.tspan: Did timing drop below the full-throttle curve?

g.data-label: Set Base Load Timing = Part-Throttle Timing
g.text: Set Base Load Timing = Part-Throttle Timing

g.data-label: Enforce minimum timing floor: Set Base Load Timing = WOTMAP
Look up engine speed advance curve from GOVNER table
g.text: Look up engine speed advance curve from GOVNER table

g.data-label: Combine speed and load timing: Total Timing = Engine Speed Timing + Base Load Timing

text.tspan: Total Timing = Engine Speed Timing + Base Load Timing

text.tspan: (Sudden pedal stomp above thresholds RTMAPE, RTRPME, RTTPSE)

g.data-label: Look up transient retard from RETTPS table based on throttle opening rate. Subtract from timing: Total Timing = Total Timing - RETTPS

text.tspan: Look up transient retard from RETTPS table based on throttle opening rate.
Subtract from timing: Total Timing = Total Timing - RETTPS

g.data-label: Leave Total Timing unchanged
Look up maximum allowable timing ceiling from SPKLMT table

Leave Total Timing unchanged

g.data-label: Retard this cylinder's timing: • In vacuum: retard at RTRDRT rate • In boost: retard at RTRDRT2 rate (above KNKOFS) • Maximum retard capped by RETMAX and KNKLIM
